title: The 1906 Nobel citation: the structure of the nervous system
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Camillo Golgi and Santiago Ramón y Cajal for their work on the structure of the nervous system.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1906 says Camillo Golgi and Santiago Ramón y Cajal received the prize in physiology or medicine in recognition of their work on the structure of the nervous system. The record dates the award 25 October 1906. Brain-region names from a later NINDS page are a different card. This one is the 1906 citation.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1906

sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
